[LCON.5.1] The language spec commits to the **categories** here;
the suite at `specs/conformance/` carries the
**individual tests**. The suite has no version of its own: the suite
a DS release tags is that release's catalogue ([RCTS.5.1.1]), and
conformance is passing the catalogue of the release a runtime claims
([LCON.1.1]). A change to the suite is reviewed like any other change,
and lands in the next release's catalogue.
